newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: VENEZUELA'S FOREIGN RESERVES FALL TO $16.375 BLN.
newsitem.headline: VENEZUELA'S FOREIGN RESERVES FALL TO $16.375 BLN.

text.p: Venezuela's foreign reserves fell $255 million, or 1.5 percent, to $16.375 billion in the week to August 4, according to figures released by the Central Bank Friday.
Reserves were down from $16.630 billion on July 28, the bank's latest weekly bulletin of indicators showed.
Since the start of the year, reserve levels have risen $1.196 billion, or 7.9 percent.
Reserves rose $5.5 billion, or 57 percent, last year to $15.179 billion.
